description: Actuele brugopeningen en beschikbare haven-ligplaatsen API is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by riverguide.eu. Open data service (API) with real-time, free information about open bridges. The available berths are also shown in the ports of Amsterdam and Rotterdam, as well as the berths under management at North Sea Port and RWS. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Up-to-date bridge openings and available port berths API" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include water. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
